accepted_task_unit.definition: One downstream task whose output passes the workload-specific frozen Quality Gate.
accepted_task_unit.rejected_task_rule: Rejected outputs retain their lifecycle costs but do not increase accepted-task volume N.

accounting_boundary.currency_conversion_rule: Each empirical observation must record its USD or USDC denomination and any conversion assumption. The two preregistered Study 003 anchors use the declared nominal rate of 1 USDC to 1 USD.

study_003_calibration_evidence.bounded_workload: Explicitly selected Biography Plate public-state reconstruction
study_003_calibration_evidence.transfer_rule: These observations are bounded calibration evidence and are not universal prices, costs, hit rates, fan-out rights, or performance claims.

N.name: lifecycle_accepted_task_volume
N.description: Accepted downstream task units in the declared lifecycle.

C1.name: fresh_reconstruction_cost_per_accepted_task
C1.description: Measured requester cost for a quality-equivalent fresh reconstruction.

q2.name: provider_cache_hit_probability
q2.description: Empirically supported provider-cache hit probability for the exact workload and lifecycle.

C2hit.name: provider_cache_hit_cost
C2hit.description: Requester cost of one quality-equivalent accepted P2 cache-hit task.

C2miss.name: provider_cache_miss_or_write_cost
C2miss.description: Requester cost of one quality-equivalent accepted P2 cache miss or cache write.

W2.name: provider_cache_lifecycle_warmup_cost
W2.description: Total cache warm-up, rewrite, or re-establishment cost not already included in C2miss.

I3.name: path3_workload_attributable_setup_cost
I3.description: Incremental Path 3 setup cost attributable to the evaluated workload.

P3a.name: governed_state_acquisition_price
P3a.description: Requester price for one governed state acquisition or required refresh.

Ktechnical.name: technical_fanout_limit
Ktechnical.description: Maximum downstream accepted-task opportunities technically coverable by one acquisition.

Krights.name: rights_fanout_limit
Krights.description: Maximum downstream accepted-task opportunities permitted by the applicable rights and license.

Klifetime.name: state_lifetime_fanout_limit
Klifetime.description: Maximum downstream accepted-task opportunities before state expiry or mandatory refresh.

Kdemand.name: remaining_demand_fanout_limit
Kdemand.description: Remaining downstream accepted-task demand available to amortize an acquisition.

lambda.name: accepted_task_arrival_rate
lambda.description: Accepted-task arrival rate used only when deriving Klifetime from state lifetime.

T.name: state_lifetime
T.description: Period during which an acquired state remains valid before mandatory refresh.

Keff.name: effective_fanout
Keff.description: Binding technical, rights, lifetime, and demand fan-out limit.

A.name: required_governed_acquisition_count
A.description: Ceiling-based acquisition count over N accepted-task opportunities.

F3.name: path3_other_fixed_lifecycle_cost
F3.description: Total preservation, storage, maintenance, refresh, synchronization, validation-state renewal, and repair cost not included elsewhere.

h.name: governed_accepted_hit_probability
h.description: Probability that the acquired governed state is located, valid, accepted, and task-appropriate.

Cr.name: local_retrieval_or_access_cost
Cr.description: Requester cost to access an already acquired governed state for one accepted hit.

Cv.name: verification_and_policy_validation_cost
Cv.description: Requester cost to verify and policy-check the governed state for one accepted hit.

Cres.name: residual_computation_cost
Cres.description: Requester computation still required after successful governed-state reuse.

Cre.name: replaceable_fresh_computation_cost
Cre.description: Fresh computation cost inside the same boundary as Cres and potentially replaceable by a governed hit.

s.name: economic_substitution_fraction
s.description: Cost-weighted fraction of Cre eliminated by a successful governed hit.

Cmiss.name: path3_miss_overhead
Cmiss.description: Requester cost to detect and route around one Path 3 miss, excluding fallback.

Cf.name: quality_equivalent_fallback_cost
Cf.description: Requester cost of the declared quality-equivalent fallback executed after a Path 3 miss.

Cbest.name: stable_best_baseline_cost_per_accepted_task
Cbest.description: Per-task best-baseline cost used only where the threshold equation declares stable per-task baseline economics.

Dincremental.name: incremental_compression_dividend
Dincremental.description: Best-baseline lifecycle cost minus governed-state lifecycle cost.

path2_lifecycle.expression: LC2 = W2 + N * (q2 * C2hit + (1 - q2) * C2miss)
path2_lifecycle.eligibility: P2 must be empirically available and quality-equivalent for the exact workload.

best_available_baseline.expression: LCbest = min(LCi for each quality-equivalent and empirically available baseline i)
best_available_baseline.two_path_special_case: LCbest = min(LC1, LC2) when P1 and P2 are the only eligible baselines

lifetime_fanout.condition: Use only when lambda and T share a declared time unit and lifetime limits fan-out.

residual_from_substitution.condition: Use when s is the controlled input and Cres is derived.

substitution_from_residual.condition: Use when Cres is directly measured and Cre is measured inside the same cost boundary.

path3_lifecycle.expression: LC3 = I3 + A * P3a + F3 + N * G

maximum_viable_acquisition_price.expression: P3a_max = (LCbest - I3 - F3 - N * G) / A
maximum_viable_acquisition_price.condition: N and A are fixed and A is greater than zero.
maximum_viable_acquisition_price.infeasible_rule: A negative result means no nonnegative acquisition price reaches Regime III under the declared conditions.

minimum_single_cycle_fanout.condition: One acquisition cycle, stable per-task Cbest and G, and Cbest greater than G.
minimum_single_cycle_fanout.infeasible_rule: If Cbest is less than or equal to G, additional fan-out cannot amortize Path 3 into Regime III.

minimum_hit_rate.expression: h_min = (I3 + A * P3a + F3 + N * Cmisspath - LCbest) / (N * (Cmisspath - Chit))
minimum_hit_rate.condition: Chit is less than Cmisspath and N is greater than zero.

interpretation.at_or_below_zero: All valid hit rates satisfy the economic threshold.
interpretation.between_zero_and_one: The result is the transition hit rate.
interpretation.above_one: Regime III is infeasible through hit-rate improvement alone.
interpretation.chit_at_or_above_miss: Increasing h cannot lower lifecycle cost under the declared costs.

minimum_substitution_fraction.expression: s_min = (I3 + A * P3a + F3 + N * (h * (Cr + Cv + Cre) + (1 - h) * Cmisspath) - LCbest) / (N * h * Cre)
minimum_substitution_fraction.condition: h is greater than zero, Cre is greater than zero, and Cres is derived from s.

interpretation.at_or_below_zero: Zero substitution is already economically sufficient.
interpretation.between_zero_and_one: The result is the transition substitution fraction.
interpretation.above_one: Regime III is infeasible through substitution improvement alone.

minimum_stable_lifecycle_volume.expression: N_min = ceil((I3 + A * P3a + F3) / (Cbest - G))
minimum_stable_lifecycle_volume.condition: A, fixed lifecycle costs, Cbest, and G remain constant across the interval and Cbest is greater than G.
minimum_stable_lifecycle_volume.piecewise_rule: Recalculate by acquisition interval whenever A changes; do not replace ceiling-based acquisition count with smooth amortization.

residual_and_substitution.rule: Exactly one of Cres or s is independently supplied for an observation; the other is derived.

fanout_rights.rule: A claimed Keff above one requires explicit technical, rights, lifetime, and demand support.
fanout_rights.unknown_limit_policy: If any binding reuse limit is unknown, Keff may not exceed one in an empirical result.

fanout_availability.rule: If a measured or derived binding fan-out limit makes Keff less than one, Path 3 is unavailable for the declared lifecycle and A must not be evaluated.

cache_availability.rule: P2 eligibility, q2, C2hit, C2miss, and W2 must be measured or explicitly bounded for the exact workload.
cache_availability.unavailable_baseline_policy: An unavailable P2 is excluded from the eligible baseline set; its unavailability does not invalidate P1 or force the entire point to be censored.

fallback.rule: Cf must identify an actually available quality-equivalent fallback and remain inside Path 3 lifecycle cost.

accepted_volume.rule: N and fan-out count only tasks passing the frozen workload-specific Quality Gate.

p1.eligible_when: Fresh reconstruction is measured and passes the frozen Quality Gate.

p2.eligible_when: Provider caching is empirically active for the exact workload and the output passes the frozen Quality Gate.

p3.eligible_when: The governed state passes the frozen Quality Gate and all acquisition, fan-out, rights, lifetime, verification, residual, miss, fallback, and fixed lifecycle inputs are measured or defensibly bounded.

classification.boundary_policy: LC3 equal to LCbest is Regime III with Dincremental equal to zero.
classification.regime_ii_zero_width_policy: Regime II may have zero width when P1 is the best available baseline.

numeric_policy.calculation_requirement: Exact decimal or rational arithmetic is canonical for deterministic artifacts.
numeric_policy.binary_float_policy: Binary floating-point output is noncanonical unless its precision and tolerance are explicitly recorded.
numeric_policy.threshold_rounding: Apply ceiling only after evaluating the unrounded positive quotient.
numeric_policy.classification_boundary: Do not use display-rounded values for regime classification.
numeric_policy.observed_value_policy: Preserve raw provider or payment values and separately record any normalized decimal value.

calibration_anchors.purpose: Lower-bound fan-out algebra check against the measured Study 003 P1 cost.
calibration_anchors.claim_boundary: Conditional idealized lower-bound anchor; not evidence of multi-use rights or zero real overhead.

calibration_anchors.purpose: Lower-bound fan-out algebra check against the measured Study 003 P2 cache-hit cost.
calibration_anchors.claim_boundary: Conditional idealized lower-bound anchor; not evidence of sustained P2 availability, multi-use rights, or zero real overhead.

scientific_integrity_rules: The v1.0 frozen engine and v1.0 release remain immutable.
Inputs must not be tuned to make Path 3 win.
Quality requirements must not be lowered after observing outputs.
Payment and HTTP success do not establish semantic success.
Provider-cache availability must not be assumed.
Multi-use rights for an x402 response must not be assumed.
Zero verification, residual, preservation, maintenance, repair, miss, refresh, or fallback cost must not be used in an empirical claim without evidence.
Production pricing must not be changed to manufacture a favorable result.
Pricing v4 must not be recommended until the relevant transition surfaces are measured.
Production price and workload-specific break-even price remain distinct.
Requester economics remain distinct from operator economics.
Monetary findings remain distinct from latency and physical-resource claims.

requirements: consume this registry without changing its equations
use canonical decimal or rational arithmetic
emit equation and registry identifiers with every result
